idea: UK property investment advisory for Chinese HNW buyers
buyer: Chinese HNW individuals buying UK property
pain: They buy badly, advised by agents with conflicting incentives
v1: An independent buying advisory for one client
verdict: Uses architecture, finance and language at once, but capital controls and market timing are against it.

why.distribution: Reachable through her father's network and China contacts, one introduction at a time.
why.demand: Buying agents are paid for exactly this; Chinese buyers are notoriously badly served.
why.fmf: Architecture for building quality, finance for value, Mandarin for trust - three assets in one product.
why.revenue_structure: One purchase per client, occasionally repeating.
why.defensibility: The trilingual, tri-skilled combination is genuinely rare.
why.tailwind: Adverse - Chinese capital controls have tightened and UK property is under tax pressure.
why.ceiling: £17k x 12 purchases = £204k, requiring twelve HNW purchase mandates a year.

ceiling_arithmetic: £17k x 12 purchases = £204k. Twelve completed HNW purchases from introduction-based flow is far beyond realistic; 2-3 = £34-51k.
carries: Three of her assets used simultaneously and a genuinely underserved, badly advised buyer.
kills: Client volume and an adverse macro backdrop of capital controls and property taxation.
test: Ask her father's network whether two families are actively buying in the UK.
test_pass: One engages for a paid advisory.
